channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Avery Bradley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Avery Bradley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Anthony Davis on Avery Bradley:

“We tried to get him back this summer as well. ... We love him here.”

Anthony Davis on Avery Bradley, Oct 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Alex Caruso on hole w/ Avery Bradley opting out:

“I'm not sure if I’m going to be the sole provider of everything that Avery did. That’s a lot to ask for just because of how good he is at what he does. But I’m definitely going to be ready to fill part of that gap.”

Alex Caruso on Avery Bradley, Jul 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Danny Green on Avery Bradley
item.description:
“Like Avery Bradley, he's one of the guys who has spoken out, but he doesn't really have social media, so [people] don't really know how he feels, they're not really able to see and hear it from him,”

Danny Green on Avery Bradley, Jun 19, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Montrezl Harrell on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Montrezl Harrell on Avery Bradley's big revenge game:

“Hats off to Avery. He made us pay, he knocked down a bunch of shots. He shot the ball well. He took 12 threes and made half of them. We gotta live with that.”

Montrezl Harrell on Avery Bradley, Mar 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Kyle Goon:Frank Vogel on Avery Bradley today:

“We’ve got two of the best players in the world competing together [LeBron and AD] and all anybody’s talking about is Avery Bradley’s tenaciousness. That speaks volumes about what he’s been able to show in the first couple of days.”

Frank Vogel on Avery Bradley, Sep 29, 2019. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Rondo on Avery Bradley:

“That’s like my little brother. I got him as a rook, and he was willing to listen from the jump … I’m excited for him… he has something to prove, but we all have something to prove.”

Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley, Sep 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Avery Bradley, Danny Green
item.description:
More from Pelinka on the signings

“KCP, we love his three-and-D mentality... To have guys like Avery Bradley, KCP and Danny Green... We're really excited about that defensive versatility.”

Rob Pelinka on Avery Bradley, Danny Green, Jul 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Hassan Whiteside continued.

“Unfortunately he got injured [in the past]. But I’ve seen his work ethic. He’s going to continue to keep getting better. I think [the trade] shocked a lot of people. Me and Blake are with the same agency. I believe him when he says he was actually shocked about it. It’s good he’s with a team that he feels like he can move on with. Even Avery Bradley and them guys going to the Clippers. The thing about trades is somebody has to want you. [The Pistons and Clippers] felt like it was even.”

Hassan Whiteside on Avery Bradley, Feb 2, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Stanley Johnson on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Talked to #PistonsStanley Johnson on trade:

“I'm very happy to have Avery Bradley. I respect the hell out of him.”

Stanley Johnson on Avery Bradley, Jul 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Gerald Green on Tony Allen, Avery Bradley
item.description:
Jay King:Green on Avery Bradley:

“I’ve played a lot of basketball. And he might be the best defender I’ve ever had, probably besides Tony Allen.”

Gerald Green on Tony Allen, Avery Bradley, Apr 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Avery Bradley, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on Avery Bradley, Jaylen Brown:

“Both guys are out for the next two gameswith the hope of doing some practice when we return.”

Brad Stevens on Avery Bradley, Jaylen Brown, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“Those are things that can't happen until the summer time anyway. Isaiah knows that we love him. He loves playing in Boston and he knows that we love him as well. And same with Avery Bradley,”

Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley, Isaiah Thomas, Jan 5, 2017. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Celtics president of basketball operations Danny Ainge was asked about Tommy’s statement Thursday morning on Toucher & Rich, and while he wouldn’t say if he’d put IT in the Top 5, he did said that Thomas and teammate Avery Bradley are certainly among the best competitors the franchise has seen.

“Tommy gets very excited in the middle of a game. I would have to say, I think Isaiah Thomas and Avery Bradley are every bit the competitors that I was around in my time with the Celtics. They’re fantastic competitors and compete night in and night out,”

Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley, Isaiah Thomas, Nov 17, 2016. Source: CBS Local.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Avery Bradley
item.description:
Brian Robb:Stevens on Bradley coming off bench:

“He’s been great about it, just like Isaiah was. I can see the spark those guys give us.”

Brad Stevens on Isaiah Thomas, Avery Bradley, Nov 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge, Avery Bradley
item.description:
Jay King:Isaiah Thomas:

“I've heard that (Danny Ainge wanted me) from (Avery Bradley), my agent, everybody in the NBA, it feels like.”

Isaiah Thomas on Danny Ainge, Avery Bradley, Feb 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley
item.description:
“Well, I haven't played defense in a couple of years, you know I've been able to hide a lot with Avery Bradley on the ball,”

Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley, Jan 5, 2015. Source: SB Nation.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley's potential:

“He has a lot of talent. The sky is the limit for Avery and he works very hard.”

Rajon Rondo on Avery Bradley, Mar 22, 2014. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:Ainge:

“We have every intention of having Avery Bradley with us in the future.”

Danny Ainge on Avery Bradley, Mar 20, 2014. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Ben Rohrbach:Pierce:

“I'd be very surprised if Avery Bradley didn't make the NBA All-Defensive team.”

Paul Pierce on Avery Bradley, Feb 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @brohrbach.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Avery Bradley
item.description:
Doc on Avery Bradley (shoulder):

“That's tough. Avery's great but we're not going to have him for a while. It's going to be great to know that we're getting him back at some point, but we're not going to rush him. And that's going to be really important that he not rush himself.”

Doc Rivers on Avery Bradley, Jul 19, 2012. Source: Sulia.
